text:
alex: hitting a production spike with 502s on /v1/generate. Looks like the route to inference-pool-us-east is returning 502/timeouts after the recent model rollout. Need an emergency routing change to fallback pool. @priya_oncall can you take?

priya_oncall: oncall — looking. any logs or a quick curl output?

alex: sample from gw logs: `ERROR upstream.go:87 upstream error: invalid response`
curl: `HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway\n{"error":"upstream error: invalid response"}`
Also seeing lots of `route_matcher.go:142 timeout sending to backend` spikes.

conner: could be related to the header-override PR we merged last night that changed `X-Model-Variant` semantics. If requests are being routed to a quantized variant that doesn't support the new tokenizer, that would explain 502s.

alex: yeah that's our hypothesis. Quick mitigation: override the route to ignore `X-Model-Variant` matching and force upstream -> stable-pool (the pre-rollout cluster).

jess: we can set an emergency override in the console: Console -> Routing -> /v1/generate -> Emergency Override -> set upstream=stable-pool and disable header matching. Or CLI: `gwctl route update --name /v1/generate --override '{"ignore_headers":true,"upstream":"stable-pool"}'`

priya_oncall: approved. I'll run the CLI. tagging @deploy-bot to record the change. post-incident ticket will be created.

priya_oncall: running: `gwctl route set-override --route /v1/generate --upstream stable-pool --ignore-headers --reason "hotfix 1712187654"`

deploy-bot: [automated] route /v1/generate override applied by priya_oncall at 1712187690. Change id: r-3a9f.

alex: errors dropped from ~15% to ~0.6% within 3 minutes. :thumbsup: Great job.

conner: good catch. Next steps: either roll back the header-override PR or patch the routing code to validate model compatibility before routing by header.

jess: agreed. I'll open a rollback PR for the header-override and assign to conner for the fix. Also adding an integration test for header->variant compatibility.

priya_oncall: note: run reconciler after manual override so infra automation doesn't clobber it: `gwctl reconcile --routes /v1/generate`

alex: creating incident INC-2024-847 in the tracker and linking this thread + logs.

conner: I'll dig into the tokenizer/quantized model mismatch and add unit tests. will update the incident with root cause and timeline.

jess: post-incident action item: update runbook "emergency-route-toggle" with exact CLI commands, console screenshots, and who must approve. Also include the reconciler step and TTL for overrides.

priya_oncall: override will remain for now. plan: validate traffic for 24h then remove if stable. I'll note the owner and add a reminder.

alex: thanks all. can we also add a metric in Console dashboard: `routes.overrides.active` and an alert if overrides are created outside scheduled maintenance?

jess: yep adding that to observability backlog.

priya_oncall: incident ticket updated with timestamps, override id r-3a9f, and link to PR for rollback.

alex: closing this slack thread. great quick response team. :tada:
